resources.string: Sign from CodexCloud using keys on this phone

Connect this app to Tailscale without a system VPN. Assuan uses tailnet port 17373 and gpg-bridge uses 17389. A blank node list allows every Tailscale node; a filled list restricts access. Choose individual local signing keys or select all. Every signature requires approval here. Android 7 or later is required.
Control server HTTPS URL (blank for Tailscale)
Allowed stable node IDs (comma separated; blank allows all)
Agent active. Tap to see login and connection status.
Key passphrase (blank for an unprotected key)

Keep this key’s passphrase in phone memory for the current connection. Approval screens fill it in automatically; you can edit it and must still approve each signature. Disconnecting clears it. A blank value clears this key’s prefill.
Connect first. Prefilled passphrases last only for the current connection.

Paste this temporary credential into gpg-bridge connect on your authorized cloud node. It expires after 8 hours; revoking the session or disconnecting invalidates it. Each signature still requires phone approval. Keep the connection string out of logs and source control.
